component.name: Systemd Manager
component.summary: Manage systemd services directly from the COSMIC panel

description.p: A native libcosmic panel applet for the Pop!_OS COSMIC desktop environment that allows you to monitor, start, stop, and restart your favorite systemd services directly from your panel.

ul.li: Real-time systemd service monitoring and control via D-Bus
Persistent pinned service list with custom aliases and labels
Automatic transition polling for services that auto-restart or take time to settle
Live autocomplete search across all installed and loaded system units

description.p: Initial release with live systemd monitoring, pin management, and search autocomplete.
